proposals.premise: The boots say EU 40 but fit like 39. Put actual fit and loan restrictions where borrowers can compare them at a glance.
proposals.opening: Desktop shows three pieces side by side, pairing stitching, lining and label photos with the skirt’s 40 cm fold-out hem, the coat’s indoor-only rule and the boots’ fit. Phone stacks those pairs beneath the date fields.
proposals.move: Enter production dates to reveal request buttons or blocking reasons on each piece. The coat shows its May 9–12 reservation and May 8 alteration slot after 16:00.
proposals.tradeoff: Fit is easy to scan, but phone comparisons take scrolling.
